# ChatModel

> Enterprise Conversational Intelligence & 24/7 AI Assistants Platform

ChatModel (https://chatmodel.in) enables businesses to deploy proprietary 24/7 AI conversational assistants, custom branded client workspaces, dynamic subdomains, and instant automated actions via webhooks.

## Core Capabilities

- **Dedicated Branded AI Workspaces**: Instant custom subdomains (e.g. `client.chatmodel.in`) with bespoke company branding, logos, theme colors, and welcome prompts.
- **24/7 Real-Time Conversational AI**: Streaming Server-Sent Events (SSE), persistent session memory, lead capture, and multi-turn contextual dialog.
- **Action Execution & Webhooks**: Direct zero-latency webhook integration with n8n, Make, Zapier, CRMs, and internal enterprise REST APIs.
- **Enterprise Security**: Strict multi-tenant isolation, SQLite WAL backend, CSRF protection, SSRF guards, rate limiting, and secure iframe embedding.

## Machine Discovery & APIs

- [API Catalog](https://chatmodel.in/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 / RFC 9264 API Catalog
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://chatmodel.in/api/openapi.json): Full OpenAPI 3.0 specification for chat and tenant endpoints
- [Chat Endpoint](https://chatmodel.in/api/chat.php): POST endpoint for sending messages to AI assistants
